failure_summary.description: Agents imported tools from a nonexistent module despite the skill requiring direct calls to injected functions.
Agents skipped updates for new criteria or repeated searches and filters for results already covered by cache.

patch.reasoning: Both patterns are already directly addressed by the skill: it prohibits importing tools and specifies when to retrieve, update, or reuse cached results. Adding more guidance would duplicate existing content; the remaining deviations are isolated rather than common skill gaps.
